asks.text: What, if anything, is wrong with this root as the definition of GelatinousSlime?
asks.decision: Adopt the existing-scope root synthesis, or identify concrete evidence requiring a different root.
asks.author: rm-role-designercodex-1794805536
asks.recommended_answer: GelatinousSlime is a universal living-body biome: the colony can take food, building material and poison relief from the same slime that absorbs unprotected people and can ultimately dissolve them. Native resistant life shares the body with outsiders already being absorbed; becoming slimified does not itself make a creature hostile. A chosen gene makes the bargain deliberate: select it from the archive, locate and extract its current with a handheld seeker, then inject a perishable dose that also brings an unwanted gene and a lasting social cost. The recipient falls into a coma and faces accelerated absorption unless a friend administers the toxic antidote in time. Ordinary exposure has its own slower course. Early ordinary film recedes away from slime ground; later film persists in ordinary country, so drying country or antidote provides the established way out. The giant Titanoslime engulfs and digests prey and grows permanently by default; a harvested, short-lived piece becomes a dangerous thrown bioweapon, including to nearby allies, and serves the campaign’s sealed-vault use. Expensive archive technology can return a dead person from their last recorded touch, while the colony’s later lives and relationships remain real. The player can use and survive this body, but its gifts carry readable, actionable consequences.
asks.routing: Recorded Evidence-for-Ask delegation; the ratification ask was never sent to the owner.

review.why: The synthesis preserves established scope. Explicit dissolution and early ordinary-film escape wording apply the reviewer’s two clarifications. No concrete evidence argues against the obvious answer; do not send a human ratification ask.

failure_modes: The body gives useful food, medicine, materials and selected genes, yet the price stops being readable or actionable. A colonist dissolves through an unclear clock or ineffective friend-treatment order, or protection/settings silently erase the bargain.

The archive and harvested giant promise consequences that their normal gameplay paths cannot deliver. A vat stalls or duplicates a person, returns the wrong recorded life or revives a superseded marriage, or a chunk fails to open the actual vault while appearing to pass helper checks.

The biome looks and plays like disconnected scenery. Native feeding, flight, outsiders, reverting farms, ruins, rain and the useful production loop are claimed from def presence while their interaction, presentation or restoration is unobserved.

root_proposal.speaker: agent
root_proposal.text: GelatinousSlime is a universal living-body biome: the colony can take food, building material and poison relief from the same slime that absorbs unprotected people and can ultimately dissolve them. Native resistant life shares the body with outsiders already being absorbed; becoming slimified does not itself make a creature hostile. A chosen gene makes the bargain deliberate: select it from the archive, locate and extract its current with a handheld seeker, then inject a perishable dose that also brings an unwanted gene and a lasting social cost. The recipient falls into a coma and faces accelerated absorption unless a friend administers the toxic antidote in time. Ordinary exposure has its own slower course. Early ordinary film recedes away from slime ground; later film persists in ordinary country, so drying country or antidote provides the established way out. The giant Titanoslime engulfs and digests prey and grows permanently by default; a harvested, short-lived piece becomes a dangerous thrown bioweapon, including to nearby allies, and serves the campaign’s sealed-vault use. Expensive archive technology can return a dead person from their last recorded touch, while the colony’s later lives and relationships remain real. The player can use and survive this body, but its gifts carry readable, actionable consequences.
